identitySignals: Agenda names 'The Regents of the University of California (Destination College Advising Corps)'; the program's own site says it operates under UC Berkeley's Center for Educational Partnerships and is governed by the Regents of the University of California
The DCAC school partners page lists Oakland High School, Oakland Technical High School and Skyline High School, all OUSD schools, matching the agenda's Oakland location
The program describes college advising for high school students, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' and 'High School Linked Learning Office' contract titles
research.notes: The contracting party is the Regents of the University of California; this profile describes the DCAC program at UC Berkeley, which is the program named in the agenda. No phone number is listed on the contact page. Registry IDs omitted (public university).

profile.address: 1 Hearst Field Annex, Building C50, Berkeley, CA 94720-1060
profile.summary: Destination College Advising Corps is a college access program run by the Center for Educational Partnerships at the University of California, Berkeley. It places recent college graduates in high schools as full-time College Adviser Fellows. They help students with college applications, financial aid and campus visits. It serves schools in Alameda, Contra Costa and Santa Clara counties.

review.notes: DCAC is a program of UC Berkeley's Center for Educational Partnerships (contracting party: The Regents of the University of California), and its school partners page lists Oakland Unified high schools; email, address, counties, services and the recent-graduate fellows (stated on the site homepage) are all supported, and the summary is neutral.
